ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Antennae: Binding his antennae keeps Reep from using his Scanning and Chameleon powers. Limited Transformation: Chameleon Boy may not be able to reproduce certain complex functions of a particular shape. Motivation: Uphold the greater good. Vulnerability: Being sprayed with cancelite or exposed to large amounts of high radiation nullifies Reep’s Chameleon power and freezes him in the shape he was in for one scene.
